title: AgentBrew: Offline Tool-Use Agent Learning from Raw Real-World Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2609.05837v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications through tool-use APIs, yet training them for specific environments remains fundamentally difficult: real-world applications provide no pre-defined tasks or verifiers, no faithful simulators, and limited budget for large-scale environment interaction. In this paper, we propose \textbf{AgentBrew}, an offline training framework that learns effective tool-use policies from a single batch of raw interaction trajectories, without task verifiers or iterative on-policy rollouts. The agent first explores the target environment to collect a raw trajectory corpus without quality filtering. translated_title: AgentBrew：从原始真实世界轨迹中学习的离线工具使用智能体
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体正越来越多地通过工具调用API部署到真实世界应用中，然而针对特定环境训练这些智能体仍然面临根本性困难：真实世界应用没有预定义的任务或验证器，没有忠实的模拟器，且大规模环境交互的预算有限。本文提出了AgentBrew，这是一个离线训练框架，能够从单批原始交互轨迹中学习有效的工具使用策略，无需任务验证器或迭代的在线策略采样。该智能体首先探索目标环境，收集未经质量过滤的原始轨迹语料库。为了从这个含噪的语料库中提取训练信号，回溯性任务推断方法基于每条轨迹的实际结果为其重建对齐的指令，而基于PMI的信用分配方法将轨迹中关于推断指令的总信息分解为…
tldr: AgentBrew是一个离线训练框架，通过回溯性任务推断和基于PMI的信用分配技术，从单批未经筛选的真实世界原始交互轨迹中学习有效的工具使用策略，无需任务验证器、模拟器或在线采样。
en_tdlr: AgentBrew is an offline training framework that learns effective tool-use policies from a single batch of unfiltered raw real-world interaction trajectories via retrospective task inference and PMI-based credit assignment, without requiring task verifiers, simulators, or on-policy rollouts.
